item: Volume backup line and the differences panel follow a language switch (row 366 b)
summary: _volRefresh, volBackupStart, volRestoreStart and loadAlternates draw through ooLive/ooLiveHtml (row 364), so their lines are redrawn in the new language on a switch with no request; four lines leave the row 352 list. A start that fails now shows the server sentence through ooServerText.
